records.title: Complete unsigned activation preparation and actual marginal LP

records.title: Expiry, child containment, cleanup quarantine and terminal work limits

records.title: RPC quantities, numeric nonce and canonical type-2 fee reconciliation

records.title: NFT earned history uses original income denominations at today prices

records.title: Independent history comparison and truthful completeness limits

records.title: Current-guide profile/custody instructions remained stale after architectural changes

records.title: Current claim activation check scope must not be overstated
records.assessment_summary: Claim preparation validates current ownership, one canonical activation weight and positive-claim consistency, plus exact ledger bindings/backing and whole-call simulation. It deliberately does not duplicate every trait/LP-valuation read performed by a display endpoint.

records.title: Permanent four-bucket reservation must count unused destinations before capacity is consumed
records.assessment_summary: Vault._reserve validates the reservation then permanently registers its logical bucket before recording the alias; _registerBucket counts even an unused destination and rejects a fifth distinct bucket. Reusing an already registered bucket does not double count; cancellation does not recover a consumed permanent identity.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Before reserving an actual destination, inspect bucketCount/bucketAt and plan the permanent slot budget; use terminal exit/redeployment if capacity is exhausted.

records.title: Immediate governance is an accepted authority model, not a remaining zero-delay timelock feature

records.title: One immutable ZZZ identity must bind contribution, native pool admission, buyback and holder return before seal
records.assessment_summary: ActivationAssets.configureZZZ binds one nonzero code/decimals/dual-price identity once before seal; Registry.configureNative admits only native ETH and the pinned Robinhood ZZZ. Access.seal requires admitted ZZZ == Migration.currentZZZ; one-time Migration.configureZZZ validates the same immutable Buyback.zzz through CustodyValidation before recording its exit pin. Thus contribution, burn and terminal return cannot be retargeted independently.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Verify the single actual ZZZ across assets/Registry/Buyback/Migration before seal and document upstream token powers.

records.title: Different-pair composition epochs and issuer-token executors are not current release features
records.assessment_summary: Registry admission enforces ETH/fixed-ZZZ, and Vault._movePool retains logical bucket shares while closing/redeploying the same ordered pair. Fresh fixed-pair pricing no longer scans foreign composition assets; compatibility historicalValue reads explicitly return0, with old ABI selectors retained.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Use same-pair reviewed pool movement for fees/liquidity changes; use terminal owner exit and redeployment for a new token or chain.

records.title: Preserving a contract owner address does not guarantee successor NFT compatibility
records.assessment_summary: NFT.canonicalWriteRecord preserves exact owner and original mint recipient in an inert V10 importer using _mint; normal transfer guards resume only after activation. The canonical peer schema/deployment commitment authenticates reviewed contracts, not whether an old escrow supports the new NFT address.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Resolve concrete escrow holders before replacement and retain their evidence beside the cutover manifest.

records.title: Failed or hostile admitted currencies can still block exact whole-ledger capture, funding or rollback
records.assessment_summary: Royalty canonicalCapture synchronizes each admitted currency, checks exact accounted liabilities/backing and snapshots it; handoff funding and abort require exact transferred balances. Activation outage isolation does not authorize omitting a failed currency from the canonical ledger.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Restrict actual registration to reviewed conventional tokens, qualify failure recovery and retain the no-write-off canonical rule.

records.title: Replace external custody-address exit with terminal proportional current-owner ETH/ZZZ return
records.assessment_summary: Paused governance starts terminal exit, snapshots every funded bucket share denominator and closes both actual LP legs without swaps. Cumulative floors in immutable mint order allocate every ETH/ZZZ raw unit; governance batches pay the current NFT owner with isolated receiver failures, and owner-only fallback selects a recipient.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Prepare/review each of beginCollectiveExit, closeBucket, allocatePrincipal and distributePrincipal; fund the sender gas and finish deferred IDs without inferring a paid prefix.

records.title: Terminal holder exit ends LP principal activity but preserves NFT transfers, future royalties and earned reward liabilities
records.assessment_summary: Terminal Access.lpExitStarted locks principal entry/maintenance/replacement; Vault.exitBucketToHolders separates actual closed principal and designated compound from Rewards and buyback backing. NFT._update keys transfers to canonical state rather than LP exit; Rewards and Royalty claims retain current-owner and economic-state checks. Royalties keep active rarity membership after LP exit.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Operate post-exit reserve burn and royalty sync/claims separately; do not clear membership or old rewards when principal is paid.

records.title: Native ETH must be actual native custody and settlement, not a cosmetic name over WETH balances
records.assessment_summary: Native currency is address0 throughout Vault receipt, Manager core settlement, exact balance checks, canonical funding and terminal payouts; no WETH wrap is used for principal. Manager immutable wrapper support belongs only to a separately reviewed earned conversion compatibility route, not this native LP accounting.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Verify actual native runtime pins and ETH sender/receiver balance deltas in deployment rehearsal while preserving historical readers.

records.title: ETH-only holder reward display requires real funded conversion, not relabelling ZZZ reward liabilities
records.assessment_summary: Rewards.convertBatch consumes each selected NFT's existing whole ZZZ individual/collective rights, executes its separate ledger-bound converter and assigns every received ETH unit back to the same rights with cumulative floors. Conversion emits conversion events rather than new earnings; source and ETH liabilities/backing remain separate. Direct original-token claim remains a holder action, so ETH-only display must wait for real conversion.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify and enable the LP-only conversion route/worker; display pending ZZZ accurately until a confirmed funded conversion.

records.title: All unclaimed economic rights follow current NFT ownership, including accrual before a transfer
records.assessment_summary: Rewards and RoyaltyRewards claims resolve current NFT ownership; ClaimRouter checks the owner before and during the atomic batch. Transfer does not pay or erase earlier unpaid whole-unit rights, and terminal principal is separately current-owner bound.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: A seller may claim before an ordinary secondary sale; no listing-time locked balance or separate sale-rights disclosure was requested. Qualify actual marketplace/callback transactions without inventing a new beneficiary or old-owner accrual split.

records.title: 80/10/5/5 is credited from actual harvested receipts, not executed by user claims
records.assessment_summary: Vault collects actual fee deltas from main and residual; FeeController.allocate classifies each20raw units16/2/1/1, holds sub20dust, and credits exact-unit Rewards for individual shares and equal activated membership. Compound and buyback balances remain designated reserves released only to fixed Vault/Buyback; claims consume already funded rights and trigger neither maintenance nor burn.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Retain separate harvest/conversion/compound/burn/claim clocks and verify real reserve conservation in operating rehearsal.

records.title: Whole-maintenance budgets must capture attributable starting principal before harvest and callbacks
records.assessment_summary: Budget.checkpoint captures the attributable starting portfolio before harvest/close/callbacks, includes released designated compound exactly once, then checks final deployed+idle at the captured vector. Execution1 now carries that frozen vector through a proved own reference-pool swap; controls/live source agreement remain validated.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify turnover and net realized results and monitor cumulative losses off-chain without silently changing the chosen per-operation policy.

records.title: Activation/growth minimums and caller-bound execution floors must be enforced on-chain
records.assessment_summary: VaultCanonical.validateContribution enforces current ownership/status, governed activation/growth minima, stronger admitted minimum and per-NFT cumulative cap; Entry.executeReviewed binds caller loss and policy before pull. Pricing.finish checks net NAV and marginal actually deployed LP against the stronger captured governing/caller floors; incumbent idle cannot subsidize an entrant.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Keep minima and source/unit displays synchronized with the admitted future policy and qualify actual Entry reviews.

records.title: Two USD sources require bounded disagreement and independent provenance, not a mean or target-pool fallback
records.assessment_summary: Oracle.setDualFeed requires two distinct source addresses and distinct nonzero declared provenance IDs, pinned code/decimals/age; _readBounds rejects spread above the lower-denominator3% policy instead of averaging it. Execution contexts capture the initial vector and revalidate live agreement; the optional pool reader uses actual external spot times reviewed ETH/USD.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Select and depth-test two independent references excluding PoPL LP; keep stale/disagreement failures rather than inventing a mean/peg/target fallback.

records.title: A dated public price observation or quoted fee is not a configured, qualified PoPL feed
records.assessment_summary: A usable Oracle price requires admitted activePolicy, matching source runtime/decimals, valid positive complete round, age and sequencer policy. Pyth adapter validates its configured feed/exponent/publish time, not arbitrary public price text.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Refresh actual same-anchor source/provider qualification and budget read/update costs before activation; publish no invented current ZZZ/ETH price.

records.title: Total loss, venue slippage, source disagreement, additional loss and caller maximum are different controls
records.assessment_summary: Budget owns separate total contribution/maintenance limits, converter owns total conversion, Strategy owns fee-adjusted additional loss, Registry owns per-venue gross/spot parameters and Oracle owns source disagreement. Caller maximum and captured revisions can only strengthen the applicable operation; raising a later policy cannot rewrite an in-flight review. Current contribution default is300bps, maintenance300, conversion100, additional100 and source agreement300.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Report each limit and remaining margin separately; adjust only the reviewed intended policy, never weaken a different guard to make a test pass.

records.title: Known directional v4 trading fees must be separated from additional execution deterioration
records.assessment_summary: Strategy._swapFee and Balancer._fee use the actual directional protocol nibble plus static LP fee minus overlap; _minimum retains both gross upper-input/lower-output floor and fee-net additional-loss ceiling. Execution1 Math.minimumOutput uses the same captured bounds with current controlled directional core fees, not a keeper quote.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify each admitted route in both directions and expose gross fee cost separately from the extra-loss budget.

records.title: Reviewed LP execution venues are independent of the LP destination and may be reconfigured after seal
records.assessment_summary: Governance configures at most four admitted hookless native ETH/fixed-ZZZ swap venues and bounded solver work; LP3 compares feasible quoted candidates and may choose zero swap. Execution1 now permits a reviewed external reference pool to be the swap venue only with exact pre/post core-state proof; it must remain distinct from the LP destination. Empty venues disables swapping without fallback.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Admit a future compatible pool through validated Registry and configureExecutionPools with review hash; review reference depth/independence and all route-specific limits.

records.title: Contribution callbacks and marginal LP measurement must isolate entrant funds from incumbent NAV
records.assessment_summary: Vault._join checkpoints/dust-settles incumbent rights before receiving entrant funds, balances only entrant budgets, recollects fees generated by entry swaps and computes incumbent NAV separately before issuing shares. Pricing.contributionNav/finish include both physical legs and attributed idle but enforce entrant-only marginal main deployment; ticks, residual L and rebalance clock are not reset.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Retain entrant/incumbent raw balance reconciliation and investigate only reachable late-fee callback behavior under the actual fixed token/periphery review.

records.title: Attributed idle and designated compound must remain owned, bounded and recoverable without arbitrary sweeping
records.assessment_summary: Vault retains per-bucket idle and designated pair compound as NFT-owned NAV with actual custody backing. Compound and same-main residual consolidation can redeploy it; emergency/terminal paths account for it rather than sweep to an operator.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify configured idle-only scheduling and thresholds against the5% idle cap, volatile markets and gas. Service policy can intentionally defer idle while the main is unsafe; use reviewed consolidation/rebalance/terminal recovery, not an arbitrary clear-to-address function.

records.title: Atomic routing must quote liquidity after own withdrawal and avoid two real balancing swaps
records.assessment_summary: Whole replacement closes both physical legs before planning; actual-core quoteCandidate reverts all provisional core changes, and Manager executes at most one selected real balancing swap. LP3 Plan carries quoted full market state; execution1 proves actual output and post-state before settlement callbacks then validates again through the operation.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify maximum catalogue/search gas and alternative viable venues while preserving zero/one actual swap and atomic rollback.

records.title: Manual ±25/±50 ZZZ-price width is distinct from an automatic volatility policy and raw inverse pool ratio
records.assessment_summary: Strategy delegates configured price-space ranges to PortfolioPolicy with explicit ZZZ-in-ETH inverse orientation and outward tick spacing; pending manual width compares at recorded centre to avoid price-drift churn. Automatic two-width policy is optional, disabled when same-side reference protection is active, and cannot use the manual exception to bypass that protection.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Read orientation and physical ticks, configure the reviewed new width, then apply at eligible guarded replacement or explicit paused emergency.

records.title: Ordinary upkeep is outside-only after hard cooldown, not a one-percent centre movement strategy
records.assessment_summary: Current Strategy.needsRebalance retains the hard minimum and manual geometry exception, but ordinary need now uses PortfolioPolicy.thresholdSide at85% of centre-to-boundary price distance. Confirmation corroborates the independent reference on the same side; Keeper scheduling adds the sampled window and durable jitter before a separately guarded Vault.rebalance.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Use the current85% geometry,600-second sampled window and60–300-second jitter in operating settings; retain independent corroboration and no automatic force fallback.

records.title: Compounding has its own interval but must not postpone or route around a needed rebalance
records.assessment_summary: Compound readiness uses its independent interval after max(lastCompound,lastRebalance), and keeper compound_policy additionally requires in-range/below-threshold main with no pending geometry. This is service policy by explicit user decision, not an on-chain ban on every outside-range compound.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify the installed worker/config, observation delays and blocked-price cases; keep independently due harvest alive. Changing this policy to no-swap outside-range reinvestment would need a separate reviewed design, not simply reordering jobs.

records.title: Hourly harvesting is independent of swapping, reserve execution and claims
records.assessment_summary: Vault.collectFees harvests the logical bucket including both physical legs and allocates actual receipts once; it needs no1000-holder loop or user claim. Current keeper defaults hourly and coalesces its own successful compound/rebalance harvest only from exact canonical receipt proof.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Rehearse target gas/funding/cadence/retry and both-leg receipt events; historical four-hour configs are not auto-upgraded. Permissionless contract harvest and the worker limited-key grant remain separate; it performs no swap or buyback.

records.title: The rebalance confirmation buffer is sampled evidence with strict gap resets, not continuous history
records.assessment_summary: Confirmation.observe records successful on-chain same-side/identity samples, clears observed failures/manual/inside conditions and restarts after a gap greater than configured maximum; _ready requires elapsed duration and a fresh final sample. Current confirmation3 defaults600seconds with maxObservationGap unset0 until review; the example config uses300-second max and240-second service checks. Raw condition reads can occur during cooldown; paid enrollment starts near eligibility.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify configured gap/inclusion and alert on repeated restarts; preserve reset acknowledgement and do not infer uninterrupted10-minute price history.

records.title: A local pump/dump alone must not satisfy the ordinary range-exit trigger
records.assessment_summary: Confirmation._condition compares the physical and independent reference thresholdSide using the same physical ticks/centre and requires the same nonzero side; one-side-only or opposite-side disagreement produces no candidate. Its identity binds fixed LP geometry, original pool controls and policy revisions so a change/restore cannot revive stale evidence.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify references excluding PoPL depth and monitor source/physical disagreement; retain same-side and execution-quality checks.

records.title: Manual emergency rebalancing intentionally has different optional financial guards and must never become an automatic fallback
records.assessment_summary: Migration.emergencyRebalance requires paused sealed governance, fresh exact custody/portfolio/control/nonce manifest and an explicit check mask; fixed Budget/Manager context alone can apply the optional financial bypass. Current emergency2 separates bit1 raw/cooldown from bit16 retained sampled evidence and keeps exact custody, token settlement, shares/reserves and terminal/canonical locks mandatory.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Prepare the exact paused emergency manifest and explicitly choose retained checks/floors; reconcile any same-key out-of-band nonce with the stopped service.

records.title: Bounded execution, cooldown and independent samples reduce but do not eliminate profitable external or keeper manipulation
records.assessment_summary: On-chain permissions, exact actual-core quote sizing, independent sampled trigger and gross/additional-loss floors constrain keeper discretion and permitted extraction; execution1 additionally rejects unpredicted reference/venue state mutation. Public traders remain free to trade ZZZ; no strategy enforces an external trader holding period or guarantees execution profitability.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Run reviewed real-depth economic scenarios and monitor cumulative outcomes before production; publish keeper release provenance without claiming it constrains an authorized on-chain capability.

records.title: Safe simplification retains callback/reentrancy/canonical barriers and historical codecs that still protect live boundaries
records.assessment_summary: Current cleanup removed unreachable foreign-LP reserve scans after proving fixed pair admission and canonical import <=2assets; zero historical compatibility selectors and old raw canonical body shapes remain explicit. Fee canonicalBarrier and distinct pre/post callback authorization/source checks still prevent capture of partial allocations. Historical codecs/journals retain their old profile rather than being interpreted as new state.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Preserve compatibility-only ABI reads and source-scoped evidence; require exact source/API/storage proof before any further simplification.

records.title: Current deployment size and compiler evidence must be source-pinned and include constructor arguments
records.assessment_summary: Function-reference import independently derives runtime/initcode bytes and ABI constructor minimum/static bounds, verifies source inventory and normal gates, and refuses inconsistent producer flags. Historical five-address Manager and59-byte Vault claims are obsolete binaries.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Review actual final renderer/NFT URI and every constructor argument with target-chain limits; minimal dynamic encoding is not deployment approval.

records.title: Historical failure attempts, fixture repairs, publication receipts and static findings are not fresh passes
records.assessment_summary: Current normal orchestration uses unique evidence directories, pinned effective profile and phase-boundary rechecks. Failed diagnostic attempts, fixture repairs and publication receipts remain exactly historical; overlapping successful stages are not additive current passes.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Run only changed/affected verification and preserve failures; check published CI for its exact revision separately.

records.title: Local keeper crash/recovery evidence does not qualify production hosting, signer operation or off-host monitoring
records.assessment_summary: Current keeper has versioned journals, pending-first canonical recovery, exact fee/nonce state, process locks and source-bound health. Old local/Ubuntu process rehearsals establish those historical fixtures, not that a current host/key/provider is running safely.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Execute authorized Unix restore/other-host fencing, competing signer, key rotation, funded-budget, alert delivery and sustained outage/restart rehearsals using current sources and preserved journals. The user-paused heartbeat stays paused.

records.title: Unsigned preparation work limits and trusted API data are backend concerns, not solved by Solidity alone
records.assessment_summary: HTTP ingress, per-client/connection admission, fresh worker isolation, cooperative library budgets and strict raw-log identities now cover the earlier missing total-work boundary. These are backend controls; Solidity rollback alone never supplied them.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify actual reverse proxy/client identity, OS hard-deadline containment, provider timeouts and hostile load. Distinguish read-only unsigned preparation from authorization to sign, and do not claim coherent RPC data is authenticated by consistency checks.

records.title: NFT earnings must be personal+collective+royalties, distinct from gross fees, claimable, claimed and conversions
records.assessment_summary: Fresh personal LP, equal activated collective LP and rarity-weighted royalties are replayed as separate earned components, then summed for each NFT at today prices. Current claimable, paid, conversion and terminal principal remain separate; historical scaled indices are not fresh7 exact books.
records.remaining_action_or_boundary: Qualify complete24-hour/all-time logs through transfers, canonical peers and long-lived checkpoints, with unavailable prices/history explicitly incomplete. A gross pool fee or conversion must never be added as that NFT holder income.

records.title: Exact asset settlement and post-callback authorization are structural safeguards, not optional economic controls
